crownPassive.name: Big teeth
crownPassive.text: Your heroes' attacks deal +1 damage to injured cards.

bond.name: Disguise
bond.text: While another of your Märchen heroes lives, Ranged attacks can't target him.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Shortcut
actions.text: Your heroes have +1 Speed for this round and the next two.

actions.name: Swallow whole
actions.text: Remove the closest enemy front-rank card, or an enemy hero on 3 health or less. It returns on 1 health if he dies. He can't swallow a Crown.
